youtube_full.title: The Sky Opened Wide | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Ezekiel 1:1, 26–28
youtube_full.description:
The Sky Opened Wide: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Ezekiel 1:1, 26–28.

Ezekiel told the people what Heavenly Father said. An army from Babylon had taken him and his people far from home.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Scout the Seeker.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Sky Opened Wide
1:14 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Scout the Seeker
1:54 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:05 Question time
3:23 Sweet dreams
3:40 More stories, the app and the paperback
